name: RC-B10-0195/2026 – After § 15 – Am 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting democratic resilience in Armenia
part_text: 15a. Warns against any attempt to turn Armenia into a mere geostrategic corridor serving external powers; reaffirms that the future of the region must be determined exclusively through the sovereignty of the people living there, with respect for the territorial integrity of states, and without foreign political, economic or security control; notes with concern the role of the United States in the South Caucasus, in particular through the so-called TRIPP (Trump Route for International Peace and Prosperity) project, of which the United States has full ownership and through which it envisages channelling raw materials, critical minerals and rare earths to US markets;
